a.lede: The iPhone Duo likely won’t make it into Santa’s sleigh this year. Here’s what Apple had to say about it.
a.title: Want an iPhone Duo for the holidays? Apple’s latest stock update isn’t reassuring

b.lede: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.
b.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve
